title: Card 022, phase A: workspace forecasting as the held-out transfer domain (domain calibration and positive control)
hypothesis: On 40 workspace forecasting questions (public daily series cut the day before a forecast date in July or August 2026, on calibration series only; outcome sealed), the incumbent harness (runner v8, claude-cli, claude-sonnet-5, pressure-recent-v3) commits a valid forecast.json and resolve.py in at least 90% of runs, exercises the process (median responses >= 4, a run call in >= 60% of runs), beats the no-data one-shot comparator by at least 0.02 Brier, and is no worse than the history-only base-rate forecaster (gold) by more than 0.02, with clean leakage checks. Only if all five gates pass can phase B (the transfer test, a separate card) run.

prerequisites.text: owner approval of this card's runs recorded in the design doc (then set status to running). The owner approved the design's five recommendations and Q6's bank rework on 2026-09-29 (section 10), which is not approval to run

cloud isolation, probe half (the owner's Q3 amendment: cloud first): experiments/cloud/probe_isolation.sh passed on the cloud VM on 2026-09-29 04:27 UTC, 5 of 5, ISOLATION: NETWORK+FILES (root, util-linux unshare 2.39.3; origin/cloud-probe-isolation, commit 11dfc71)

cloud isolation, runner half: run_pilot.py --sandbox unshare-rnm (experiments/p6_pilot/sandbox.py) runs every run-tool and evaluator command of a forecast task in new user, mount and network namespaces with the checkout's experiments/, .git, the raw cache and ~/harness-sealed hidden; in the execution contract and the hash. Tested 2026-09-29 in podman python:3.11-slim as root (--cpus 1): the peeker control is rejected unwrapped (network, checkout, git, evaluator bundle and a planted sealed file all reached) and accepted wrapped (all blocked); gold commits wrapped with 52/52 agreement. The card's peeker control (expect accepted) re-checks it on the VM before any model run

the recall probe (probe_recall.py: the 200 bank questions and the 20 pre-cutoff positive-control questions, recall_control.json) and the one-shot comparator's call (oneshot_forecast.py --run --live) are built and tested against a stub CLI (cli_ask.py: claude_cli.py's isolation and model pin); the smoke with the pinned model (3 recall + 3 one-shot calls, under $1) is still to run, with approval

the post-run leakage audit (audit_forecast_runs.py: network words in commands and written files, dates on or after T in tool results beyond those the question states, checker tampering in written code; one hit stops the campaign) is built and tested

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: The code incumbent's policy, tools, guards and client on forecast tasks: the runner gives a forecast task the forecast instructions and evaluate_forecast.py, and each task's contract (snapshot, statement, question.md and README digests, evaluator files) enters its hash, so every question has its own hash. Cloud first (trusted-local in the VM) with --sandbox unshare-rnm, which the execution contract records; the hash also contains the VM's task interpreter path, so --plan on the VM prints the hashes the runs must record. Fallback if the VM refuses the namespaces: the host OCI image (localhost/reticle-p6-task:py313-v1, image id 8b74015e5079..., podman), a card edit before approval.

calibration.note: The frozen seed-22 draw v2 (build_bank.py): 40 questions on the 13 calibration series, forecast dates 2026-07-06..08-24; no calibration series appears in the sealed or reserve sets.

repeat.note: 20 calibration questions run a second time, for the run-to-run SD (the re-estimation rule of design section 4).

controls.note: Two calibration questions (a FRED level series and a count) for the scripted controls.

campaign.note: Design section 5: 40 + 20 incumbent runs, about $0.25 per run at list price (extrapolated from code repair; p90 about $0.50), so about $15; the campaign checkpoints once the CLI's list-price estimates reach $25. The recall probe and one-shot comparator (about $4) are separate invocations, not budgeted here. pytest_timeout_seconds is the forecast evaluator's time limit (plus the runner's 120 s), not a pytest limit.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: No repeat guard, as card 007; repeat flags are derived from the transcripts afterwards.
manual: Leakage stops the campaign: one hit in audit_forecast_runs.py (run it after every 10 runs and at the end), a peek that is not blocked, or a read outside the workspace.
A model_pin_violation (the CLI answered with a model other than claude-sonnet-5) or a change of reported_model or CLI version stops the campaign; the recall probe is rerun before any resume.

The sealed resolutions (~/harness-sealed/022/resolutions.json, sha256 bc4a1221a4d7e56fad672f89e91a940ef1bcac561fb1f1da4e2e342529a55826) are never copied to the machine that runs the campaign (the cloud VM runs as root, so nothing there may hold an outcome; the sandbox also hides ~/harness-sealed). Scoring happens afterwards on the host with score_forecasts.py --resolutions-sha256 <that value>, which refuses any other file.
Do not tune statements, budgets, the bank or the environment during the card; any change is a new card.

decision_rule: Phase A gates (design section 5), all required before phase B: (1) committed (run_card's accepted) in at least 90% of incumbent runs; (2) median responses of at least 4, and a run call in at least 60% of runs; (3) mean paired Brier of the incumbent at least 0.02 below the one-shot comparator's (score_forecasts.py, calibration set); (4) leakage checks clean (audit, peeker, recall probe with its pre-cutoff positive control); (5) the incumbent's mean Brier no more than 0.02 above gold's (the history-only base rate). A failed gate stops the card and is reported as a finding about the domain. The 20-question repeat block estimates the run-to-run SD for the sealed-set re-estimation rule.
notes: Phase A only. Phase B (incumbent vs the selected change(s) on the 120 sealed questions of 36 series, design section 5) is not in this card: it needs near transfer on a second repository (Q2), a change that passes S6 acceptance, and card 021's or 014's result. The bank now meets the design's size (40/120/40, series-disjoint; section 10, Q6); phase A's repeat block fixes the sealed size through the re-estimation rule (section 4).
Accepted means committed, not correct: no outcome exists at run time. Brier and log score come afterwards from score_forecasts.py against the sealed resolutions pinned above.
Budgets are the design's (12 responses, 15 attempts, 600 active s, 80,000 context bytes, 4,096 max tokens, 120 s commands, 1,200 s per invocation).
Cloud first per the owner's amendment to Q3, confirmed by the VM probe; the OCI image is the fallback (arm note).
